question.text: Which of the following property of alkaline earth metal increases with their atomic number?

options.text: solubility of their hydroxides in water
solubility of their sulphate in water

solution.text: The lattice energy of the hydroxides of alkaline earth metal decreases more rapidly than their hydration energy leading to more negative value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ΔH</mi><mtext>sol</mtext></msub></math> down the group. More negative is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ΔH</mi><mtext>sol</mtext></msub></math>, more is the solubility of compounds. Hence the solubility of hydroxides of alkaline earth metal increases with their atomic number.
